Alcohol
A quick way to boost the <hint=hint_mood>mood</hint> of characters.

Peasants and warriors purchase alcohol at the <hint=hint_bld_tavern>Tavern</hint>, while lords and prisoners bring it from the warehouse.

There are three types of alcohol, each differing in the strength of the positive effect: 
$ Rutabaga <hint=hint_resource_moonshine>Moonshine</hint>, 
$ Neutral <hint=hint_resource_beer>Beer</hint>,
$ Flavorful and aromatic <hint=hint_resource_ale>Ale</hint>.

Characters will prioritize consuming ale first and moonshine last.

Effects last for {alcohol_duration} hours:
$ Strong positive <hint=hint_thought>thought</hint>
$ Increased <hint=hint_interest>interest</hint> in other characters

May cause <hint=hint_th_hangover>hangover</hint> or alcoholism.

You can regulate alcohol sales in the <hint=hint_finance_menu>Finance menu</hint>.

Moonshine Alcohol. Gives a positive thought +{thought} for several hours, affecting the average mood throughout the day. Also used in the creation of Nectar Production $ Produced in a Brewery. $ Requires 1 for production. $ Sold in a Tavern.

Beer Alcohol. Gives a positive thought +{thought} for several hours, affecting the average mood throughout the day. Production $ Produced in a Brewery. $ Requires 0.5 and 0.5 for production. $ Sold in a Tavern.

Holy Rings A luxury that enhances the impression of a lord, increasing interest in them. Characteristics $ Holy rings cannot be produced; they can only be purchased from Holy Caravans.

Gold The money of Norland; a universally accepted medium of exchange. Characteristics $ A shortage can cause a negative thought, while abundance can cause a positive one. $ A significant difference in Gold can cause Envy. $ Only the Loving Family has the right to mint coins, thus selling goods to the Holy Caravan is the primary way of obtaining them.

Wood A basic resource. Used in construction, agriculture, and in the production of other resources. Characteristics $ Mass deforestation on the map can lead to a decrease in soil fertility. Production $ Harvested in the forest by workers of the Lumbermill.
Coal An intermediate resource used in the creation of other resources, such as Tools. Production $ Produced in a Coal Furnace. $ Requires 1 for production.
Iron A basic resource. Mainly used in the production of other resources, such as Tools, and for upgrading buildings. Characteristics $ Iron reserves deplete over time. Production $ Mined in Mines.
